paite: Huan Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "TOUPA'N amite tung ah, Israelte tung ah kumpipa dia nang sathau hon nilh dia ahon sawl ka hi. Huaiziak in tu in TOUPA thugen ngaikhia in.
heading: Amalek Mite Toh Kidouna

paite: Sepaihte' TOUPA'N, Amalek mite'n Israelte tung a athilhih uh, Aigupta gam a pan ahong pawtkhiak lai ua lampi a ana daldan ka theigige hi.

Amalekte dou ding in kuan inla, athil neih tengteng uh hawi himhim nei lou in hihmang vek in. Numei leh pasal, naungek leh nawi ne lai, bawngtal leh belam, sangawngsau leh sabiltung tan in that vek in, achi,” achi hi.
Huchi in Saul in mipite asamkhawm a, Telaim ah amaute asim a, sepaih nuainih leh Judah mi singkhat ahi uh.
Saul Amalekte khua atungsuk a, phaizang ah ana buk hi.

Saul in Kente kiang ah, "Hong pawt unla, Amalekte a pan kihuikhia un. Huchi lou in zaw, ka hon that tel kha ding. Nou zaw Israel suan tengteng Aigupta a pan ahong pawtkhiak lai un na na hehpih ua," achi hi. Huchi in Kente Amalek mite lak a pan apawtkhia uhi.
Saul in Amalek mite Havilah a pan Aigupta gam gei a Shur tan in adou hi.
Amalek mite kumpipa Agag ahingmat a, mipi tengteng namsau in asatlum vek hi.
Himahleh Saul leh mipite'n Agag ahawi ua, belam leh bawngtal hoihhoih, athauthau, belamnoute, ahoih tengteng athat nuam kei uh. Ahoih lou leh adeih louh peuhmah uh bel athat vek uhi.
TOUPA thu Samuel kiang ah ahong tung hi,
heading: Saul Kumpipa Ahihna Nial Ahi

paite: "Saul kumpipa dia ka seh ka kisik hi. Hon zui lai hon kinungngatsan in ka thupiak bang in ahih ngal kei a," achi hi. Hiai in Samuel ahehsak a, zankhua in TOUPA asam hi.
Saul mu ding in Samuel zingkhangpi in athou a, Karmel ah Saul ahoh hi. Ngai in, huai ah amah theihgigena suang aphut a, akik nawn a, apai zel a, Gilgal ah apaisukta, chih Samuel hilh in a-om hi.
Saul kiang Samuel ahong tung a, akiang ah, "TOUPA'N hon vualzawl hen. TOUPA thupiak bang in ka hihta," achi hi.
Samuel in, "Tua belam ham ka bil a hong lut leh bawng ham ka zakte bangchidan ahi dia le?" achi hi.
Saul in, "Amalek mite ahon laksak uh ahi. TOUPA na Pathian kiang a kithoihna ding in mipite'n belam leh bawngtal hoihhoih ahawi uhi. Adang tengteng ahihleh ka that vek uhi," achi hi.
Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "Dai in, TOUPA'N tuzan a ka kiang a athugen ka hon hilh ding," achi hi. Ama'n akiang ah, "Gen dih ve," achi hi.
Samuel in, "Nang ngaih in mi neuchik himah lechin leng, Israel nam heutu dia bawl na hi kei maw? TOUPA'N Israelte kumpipa ding in sathau ahon nilh hi.
TOUPA'N nang ahon sawlkhia a, kuan inla, mikhialte, Amalek mite that vek inla, amanthat sipsip masiah uh dou zel in, ahon chi hi.
Bang ding a TOUPA thu zui lou a, gallak thilte aboh a na boh a, TOUPA mitmuh a thil hoih lou na hih mawk?" achi hi.
Saul in Samuel kiang ah, "E, TOUPA thu ka zui vo oi, TOUPA'N hon sawlna ah ka hoh a, Amalek kumpipa Agag ka hon man a, Amalek mite ka that vek vo oi.
Himahleh mipite'n gallak thil belam leh bawngtal hihman ding lak ah ahoihhoih Gilgal a TOUPA na Pathian kiang a kithoihna ding in ahon tawi uh," achi hi.
Samuel in, "TOUPA'N TOUPA thu zuih makipahpih bang in halmang thillatte leh kithoihnate akipahpih a hia? Ngai in, kithoihna sang in thuman ahoihzaw a, belamtal thau sang in athu man ahoihzaw hi.
Helna zaw aisan khelhna toh akibang a, engtatna zaw milim biakna toh akikim hi. TOUPA thu na nial ziak in ama'n leng kumpipa ding in nang ahon nialta," achi hi.
Saul in Samuel kiangah, "Mipite lau a, athu uh ka manna lam in TOUPA thupiak leh nang thu ka na bohse maizen a; ka na khialta hi.
Huaiziak in tu in ka khelhna ngaidam inla, TOUPA ka biaktheihna ding in kei lam ah hong kihei nawn in," achi hi.
Samuel in Saul kiang ah, "TOUPA thu na nialta a, nang lam ah ka hong kihei nawn kei ding. TOUPA'N Israelte kumpipa ding in ahon deih kei," achi hi.
Huchi in Samuel pai dia akiheileh apuan mong ah alen a, akekta hi.
Huchi in Samuel in akiang ah, "Tuni a pan ToUPA'N Israel gam ahon sutta, nang sang a hoihzaw na inveng kiang ah apeta hi.
Israelte thagui azuau kei dia, akisik sam kei ding. Mihing bang a kisik nawn themthum mi ahi ngal kei hi," achi hi.
Huchi in ama'n, “Ka na khialta hi. Himahleh ka mite upate leh Israelte ma a hon zahtak ding in ka hon ngen hi. TOUPA na Pathian ka biaktheihna ding in kei lam ah hong kihei in aw," achi hi.
Huchi in Samuel in Saul apaipih a, Saul in TOUPA abia hi.
Samuel in, "Amalek mite kumpipa Agag ka kiang ah hon pi un," achi hi. Samuel kiang ah ling kawm in Agag ava hoh hi. Agag in, "Sihna mulkimhuai in hon paikhengta ahi ve," achi hi.
Samuel in, "Na namsau in numeite ta nei lou dia abawl bang in na nu leng numei lak a ta neiloumi ahi ding," achi hi. Huchi in Samuel in Gilgal ah TOUPA ma ah Agag asatzanta hi.
Huchi in Ramah ah Samuel apai a; Saul bel a-inn ah Saul omna khua Gibeah ah apaitou hi.
Huchi in Samuel in asih ni pha in Saul amu nawnta kei hi. Samuel bel Saul ziak in alungkham hi. Israelte kumpipa dia Saul ana tel ziak in TOUPA akisik hi.
